cases.title: Fix the Room, Not the Whole House
cases.audience: A householder troubleshooting weak Wi-Fi in one room
cases.user_goal: Locate the likely weak-signal area, test one change at a time, and choose a proportionate next action.

content_basis.problem_evidence: Router status pages report house-level connection health while users experience room-level dead zones. Design hypothesis only.

actions: move router higher and away from the microwave
test kitchen again in the same spot
add a mesh point only if the test still fails

content_basis.limitations: Floor plan, signal values in dBm, device locations, and actions are fictional. The guide must not claim a guaranteed fix or a measured survey.

cases.visual_intent: A clean floor plan with signal contours, one highlighted test point, and a three-step action rail; the weakest room is obvious without turning the whole house into a heat map.

completion_criteria.condition: Router location, three demo signal readings, and the kitchen test point are visible and correctly associated.
completion_criteria.method: Inspect each room label and compare with demo_values.

completion_criteria.condition: The action sequence tests one change before recommending a mesh point, avoiding an immediate upsell.
completion_criteria.method: Trace the three-step rail and inspect conditional wording.

completion_criteria.condition: Signal contours and dBm values are labelled fictional demonstration data, not a measured or guaranteed diagnosis.
completion_criteria.method: Inspect the legend, demo notice, and limitation copy.

completion_criteria.condition: Contours do not obscure room labels or action text, and the floor plan remains readable at 50%.
completion_criteria.method: Review full PNG, thumbnail, and crops around the kitchen test point.

final_collection_review.observed: 十张最终服务原图均已逐张实际打开，最终整体接触表和两页局部细节图也已查看。十件作品分别使用财务瀑布、服务状态网络、成本堆栈、单位价格尺、依赖河、保险场景树、决策Dial、分类传送带、影响地图和户型诊断，主视觉逻辑与决策任务独立。所有账单、租金、单位价、权重/工时和年均成本均经重新计算；所有人物、数据、城市规则、政策和测量均标为虚构演示，不声称现场调研或用户实验。没有未解决交付缺陷。
